description: Complete end-to-end testing suite for restaurant menu application with customer experience, admin dashboard, image upload, and PWA features

testScenarios.name: Complete Customer Journey
testScenarios.description: Test the complete customer experience from menu browsing to order placement

steps.expectedResult: Page loads within 3 seconds, menu items are visible
validation: Confirm menu items are visible with images

steps.description: Switch between English, Hindi, and Telugu
steps.expectedResult: Menu items and descriptions translate correctly

steps.description: Click through different menu categories
steps.expectedResult: Items filter correctly by category
validation: Click on 'All' to show all items

steps.description: Add 3-4 different items to cart
steps.expectedResult: Items are added to cart, cart icon updates
validation: Verify cart icon shows item count
Check cart drawer opens when clicked
Confirm items are listed in cart

steps.description: Modify quantities and remove items
steps.expectedResult: Cart updates correctly, totals calculate properly

steps.description: Fill out checkout form and place order
steps.expectedResult: Order is placed successfully
validation: Fill in customer details (name, phone, table)

testScenarios.name: Admin Dashboard Testing
testScenarios.description: Test admin dashboard functionality including menu management and order handling

steps.expectedResult: Login page loads with form
validation: Check email and password fields are present

steps.description: Use admin credentials to login
steps.expectedResult: Successfully logged in to admin dashboard

steps.description: Add, edit, and delete menu items
steps.expectedResult: Menu items can be managed successfully
validation: Fill in item details (name, description, price, category)
Upload an image using drag & drop
Verify item appears in menu list

steps.description: Upload images for menu items
steps.expectedResult: Images upload and display correctly
validation: Drag and drop an image file
Check file validation (try invalid file types)
Confirm image is saved with item

steps.description: Handle incoming orders
steps.expectedResult: Orders appear in real-time and can be updated
validation: Place a test order from customer side
Verify order appears in admin dashboard
Check order details are displayed correctly

steps.description: View real-time analytics and reports
steps.expectedResult: Analytics display real data and update in real-time

testScenarios.name: PWA Features Testing
testScenarios.description: Test Progressive Web App features including offline functionality and installation

steps.description: Check if app can be installed
steps.expectedResult: Install prompt appears or app can be installed
validation: Check if 'Add to Home Screen' prompt appears
Confirm app icon appears on home screen

steps.description: Test app behavior when offline
steps.expectedResult: App works offline with cached content

steps.description: Verify service worker registration and caching
steps.expectedResult: Service worker is registered and caching works

steps.description: Verify app feels like a native application
steps.expectedResult: Smooth navigation and native-like experience

testScenarios.name: Performance Testing
testScenarios.description: Test application performance and loading times

steps.description: Measure page load times
steps.expectedResult: Pages load within acceptable time limits

steps.description: Test app on different screen sizes
steps.expectedResult: App works well on all device sizes
validation: Verify touch targets are appropriate size

steps.description: Test search performance and accuracy
steps.expectedResult: Search works quickly and accurately

testScenarios.name: Error Handling Testing
testScenarios.description: Test application error handling and edge cases

steps.description: Test app behavior when network fails
steps.expectedResult: App handles network errors gracefully

steps.description: Test form validation and error messages
steps.expectedResult: Forms validate input and show appropriate errors

steps.description: Test application with edge case scenarios
steps.expectedResult: App handles edge cases gracefully
validation: Test with very long item names
